T: From New York back to the bush.
D: Mick takes Sue home to the Top End while drug dealers chase them.
P: Serve the mains when Mick fakes Walter's death by a croc.
S: Yabby tails in lemon mayo on buttered soft rolls. Mick catches them by hand in the billabong.

Chop 400g cooked yabby or bug tail meat (or cooked prawns) and mix with 4 tbsp whole egg mayonnaise, the zest and a squeeze of a lemon and chopped chives. Split and butter 8 small soft rolls, toast them lightly and fill.
400g cooked yabby, bug tail or prawn meat@Seafood
Beef snags in white bread, fried onions, tomato sauce. Walkabout Creek welcomes Mick home.

Thick beef sausages grilled slowly, rolled in white bread with fried onions and tomato sauce. Grill 8 thick beef sausages slowly over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning often. Fry 2 sliced onions until soft and golden. Wrap each sausage in a slice of white bread with onions and a squeeze of tomato sauce.
Kakadu plum or green mango with chilli and lime, corn chips to scoop. From Belonga Mick
Kakadu plum or green mango diced with chilli, lime, red onion and coriander, corn chips or grilled flatbread.
Kakadu plum powder or green mango@Produce
M: Whole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in paperbark, cooked over coals.

Whole barramundi stuffed with lemon, ginger and coriander, wrapped in paperbark, cooked over coals. Stuff a 1.5kg whole barramundi with lemon slices, a sliced knob of ginger and a bunch of coriander. Dot with 50g butter and wrap well in foil. Cook over hot coals or a hot grill for 20 minutes, turning once.
Rump steak on Turkish with beetroot, onion and cheddar. Lunch before the subway handoff
Rump seared hard and rested, sliced, on toasted Turkish with caramelised onion, melted cheddar, beetroot and barbecue sauce.
W: Thick pancakes under toasted macadamias and bush honey. Breakfast at Mick's camp, back in the bush.

Whisk 300g self-raising flour, 2 tbsp sugar, 2 eggs and 375ml milk into a thick batter. Cook ladlefuls in a buttered pan for 2 minutes a side. Stack and top with 80g toasted chopped macadamias and plenty of honey.
K: Top End lemon myrtle gin and tonic
Gin and tonic with a lemon myrtle sugar rim and a squeeze of lime

Gin over ice with tonic, a lemon myrtle sugar rim and fresh lime, sharp and cold for a hot night in the bush. Mix 1 tbsp caster sugar with 1 tsp ground lemon myrtle on a plate. Run lime around 4 glass rims and dip. Fill with ice, add 45ml gin and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml tonic water. Add a lime wheel.
